newsitem.title: USA: Telco sees Q3 shr loss of $0.20 to $0.40.
newsitem.headline: Telco sees Q3 shr loss of $0.20 to $0.40.

text.p: Telco Systems Inc. said Friday that it expects a loss in its third fiscal quarter, ended May 25, of betwen $0.20 and 40.40 per share. Revenues, added the company, are expected to be about equal with those of the previous quarter, which were $27.3 million.
The company said the expected loss was a result of a decline in its gross margin and increased spending in the quarter.
Telco said that while shipments and orders increased for its Access60 product, cost improvements in that product have not materialized as fast as had been expected.
The company added that the increasing proportion of Access60 product and the increased shipments at volume discounts to a major customer have affected overall gross margins.

Telco said that it expects to increase spending in product development while reducing its manufacturing costs and spending in other areas of the business. It expects to report its financial results for the quarter ending May 25, 1997 on June 12, 1997.
